tcgcsv-84168.headline: Up 32% in a week: Chandelure EX (Legendary Treasures) 77/113 went from $11.22 on Oct 20 to $14.81 on Oct 27, and is up 36% over 30 days, up 42% over 90 days and up 118% over a year. That beats its set over 30 days: up 36% against a +2.5% median for 53 Legendary Treasures items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.6% for 9937 priced items across the market. That is its highest price on file, back to Feb 8, 2024, above the earlier peak of $14.66 on Oct 25.
